reviews.title: Fantastic memory for a fantastic price.
reviews.comment:
I recently purchased the G.Skill Trident Z RGB Series 32GB (2 x 16GB) 288-Pin SDRAM DDR4 3600 CL18-22-22-42 1.35V Dual Channel Desktop Memory for my gaming PC and I am extremely satisfied with my purchase.
First and foremost, the RGB lighting on this memory is absolutely stunning. The colors are vibrant and the lighting effects are smooth and seamless. It's a great addition to my gaming setup and adds a lot of visual appeal.
In terms of performance, this memory does not disappoint. The 3600MHz speed is lightning fast and allows my PC to run games and applications with ease. I've noticed a good improvement in the overall performance of my PC since installing this memory.
Installation was a breeze and the memory fit perfectly into my motherboard. The build quality is top-notch and the heatsinks on the memory modules help keep them cool during heavy usage.
Overall, I highly recommend the G.Skill Trident Z RGB Series 32GB (2 x 16GB) 288-Pin SDRAM DDR4 3600 CL18-22-22-42 1.35V Dual Channel Desktop Memory to anyone looking for a high-quality, high-performance memory upgrade for their PC. The RGB lighting is a great bonus, but the real star of the show here is the impressive speed and reliability of this memory.

reviews.title: Reliable and easy to install
reviews.comment:
It was a very easy install, worked right away, and it was easy to turn on XMP in the bios settings to get the full speed of the ram. Having zero issues so far. They are very pretty rainbow colored rgb lights which looks good with glass panels.
The price of ram is still quite high but if you're needing an upgrade then it is worth it.
